svg.title: Disaster Recovery Strategies
svg.desc: Disaster Recovery Strategies. Backup & restore, pilot light, warm standby, active-active: trading cost against RTO and RPO. Step 1, Backup and restore: Backup and restore: only backups wait. After a disaster everything is rebuilt, which takes hours. Step 2, Pilot light: Pilot light: data stays live in the recovery region, but app servers start only after a disaster. Step 3, Warm standby: Warm standby: a small, complete copy always runs. Recovery scales it up and shifts the traffic. Step 4, Multi-site active/active: Active/active: both regions always serve, so a failure only shifts traffic, at the highest cost.

g.text: Backup and restore: only backups wait. After a disaster everything is rebuilt, which takes hours.
Pilot light: data stays live in the recovery region, but app servers start only after a disaster.
Warm standby: a small, complete copy always runs. Recovery scales it up and shifts the traffic.
Active/active: both regions always serve, so a failure only shifts traffic, at the highest cost.
